snippet.title: Free Browser MMO: A Whole World Under the Sea (No Download) | BalenaScape
snippet.description:
Play free in your browser (PC, no download): https://play.balenascape.com/
Deepdiving is the seventeenth skill in BalenaScape: a diving bell, an oxygen meter, reefs, shipwrecks and two sea bosses.
▶ Play free in your browser: https://play.balenascape.com/
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/E9QCtTY3q2 (the first 100 members get the Early Adventurer role)
🌍 Website: https://balenascape.com/

BalenaScape is a free old-school-style MMO you play in your browser. No download and no email needed. 17 skills to 99, 13 quests, 18 bosses, 9 minigames and 3 spellbooks. Early access, made by a small team.
